sections.title: RP2040, USB-C input and logic power
sections.purpose: Receive USB-C power, generate logic supplies, run and flash firmware.
notes: Integrated core: separate 5.1k CC pull-downs, USB ESD and 27 ohm data resistors, AP2112K 3.3 V regulator, RP2040, 12 MHz crystal, 2 MB QSPI, BOOTSEL and RUN service switches. Label input, regulator and MCU subsections clearly.
Use 100 nF supply-pin decoupling, 1 uF internal-regulator input/output bypass, 15 pF crystal caps, and 1 uF AP2112 input/output capacitors.
Requires known 5 V USB-C supply advertising at least 1.5 A; no PD negotiation or current detection.
Logic peak 130.34 mA is below conservative 150 mA allocation and AP2112 600 mA rating. USB peak approximately 635.44 mA is below 1500 mA. Motor bypasses logic regulator.
Service buttons are not application controls; no expansion headers.
Unreviewed block: RP2040 bare-chip USB motor-controller core.

reference.quote: Complete schematic of the minimal board

sections.title: 5 V brushed motor driver
sections.purpose: PWM-drive one small 5 V brushed motor from VBUS.
notes: DRV8833 bridge A feeds two-pin motor connector; unused bridge B inputs and BISEN grounded, outputs unconnected.
10 nF VM-to-VCP, 2.2 uF VINT bypass, 2x10 uF VM ceramics and 47 uF bulk. 47k nSLEEP pull-up.
0.51 ohm sense resistor sets approximately 392 mA nominal chopping, not a hard stall-current limit. Actual motor startup/stall, thermal behavior, USB inrush and regeneration require qualification.
GP14 PWM drives IN1; GP15 holds IN2 low. Startup and stop both low/coast. Fixed forward direction.
Unreviewed block: DRV8833 single brushed DC motor, qualified5V USB supply.

reference.quote: The VM pin should be bypassed to GND using low-ESR ceramic bypass capacitors

sections.title: Single user button
notes: Active-low GP0 input with 10k pull-up to 3.3 V. Debounce 30 ms.
Each press advances stopped, 40%, 70%, 100%, stopped. Always start stopped; no saved settings.
